title: AgriDas
description: A marketplace connecting farmers, labour providers, and machinery providers.
highlights: Built REST APIs for listings, bookings, and accounts with protected, role-scoped access for three user roles.
Implemented proximity discovery with MongoDB 2dsphere indexes and aggregation pipelines, achieving sub-200 ms responses.
Added JWT authentication and Google OAuth, plus a reusable React frontend with lazy loading and code splitting.

title: Event Trigger Engine
description: A lightweight background job engine for triggering, scheduling, and reliably executing asynchronous tasks.
highlights: Returns API acknowledgements immediately while dedicated workers process long-running jobs asynchronously.
Supports event-driven, delayed, and scheduled jobs with persistent queues, sampling, deduplication, and retries.
Persists tasks and events with PostgreSQL and TypeORM; provides authenticated REST APIs with request validation.

title: Social Media Backend
description: A containerized social platform API for secure user, content, and engagement workflows.
highlights: Created REST APIs with JWT authentication and role-based authorization for social-media workflows.
Used Redis to cache feed and profile endpoints, reducing average response time from 320 ms to 55 ms.
Deployed the Dockerized application to AWS EC2, with PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy powering relational data.
